verdict.rationale: USCIS is a government immigration agency. Its products are an online filing portal and a few read/create APIs (Case Status, FOIA). User-defined recurring job or workflow scheduling is an automation-platform capability outside this kind of service. The Case Status API's mention of 'regular access' describes the intended consumers, not a scheduling feature the product ships, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
